request.description: Records consent or a lawful basis captured outside the app: on a call, from an import, a web form, an SMS/WhatsApp link or a partner. `basis` is `consent` (default) or `legitimate_use` where the purpose allows it. Grants through `web_form`, `sms_link`, `whatsapp_link` or `partner_assisted` must cite `templateVersionId`; grants without a template need `evidence` (e.g. "website form checkbox, 2026-08-14"). Scoped purposes take `organizationIds` of the right organization type. Staff only. Reading needs party read access; recording needs party update access (ops lead, super admin).
